requirements: Shops have staff (shop_staff). Staff read, add, edit and remove the items of their shops and the photos of those items. A photo always belongs to the same shop as its item (item_photos.shop_id is the item's shop_id), and removing an item removes its photos.
expected_properties: Items are only seen and changed within the staff member's shops.
Photos are only seen and changed within the staff member's shops.
A photo always belongs to the same shop as its item.
Leaving a shop never grants access.
The application role may only use items and item_photos and read shop_staff.
Staff can read the items of their shops.
Staff can add a photo to an item of their shop.
Staff can remove an item of their shop, with its photos.
